title: The Dabbling Duck Charters
specs: Experienced captains with US Coast Guard Master Captain licenses
Boat has bimini tops for shade
includes: Storage space for coolers and towels
blurb: Guests take chartered pontoon boat trips on Center Hill Lake to visit waterfalls, swim, and enjoy sunset cruises. Excursions last approximately 2-3 hours and include at least 1 hour of swimming or viewing at the waterfall. The boats have bimini tops for shade and life vests in various sizes are provided.
extraNote: No refunds unless captain cancels due to dangerous weather conditions · Captain determines if weather is charterable; light rain and passing storms usually allowed · Rescheduling is always an option if weather is uncharterable · Cookeville Boat Dock Marina, slip number 1009, Baxter, Tennessee. Park on the left side of the lot near the marina. · 2026 season runs as long as water levels allow access to the falls

quotes.text: +1My family and I took a tour to both waterfalls! It was beautiful! Both Captain Shane and Captain Jamie were kind and told us about the area as well as some of their stories and experiences. Captain Jamie took us closer to the waterfalls telling what the easiest route was to get up close without getting hurt! And then took so many amazing photos of us that way we could unplug and just enjoy the family time together! Overall the trip was amazing I cannot recommend it enough!!!

quotes.author: Erika Taylor
quotes.text: So worth the trip this couple was absolutely fantastic. It was like having the best boat ride and hanging out with your friends. Everyone kayaking seemed to be kindof hot and miserable because it was a heat wave. The ride to the falls was peaceful good music and energy. They let us take as much time at the falls as we needed. Never felt rushed. The walk is very little when the falls are low. I would not let that deter you from a very good time.

quotes.author: Bo B
quotes.text: What a fun trip to the waterfalls! This was AMAZING! The waterfalls are breathtaking! And the captains are GREAT as well. Captain Shane navigated the boat through some pretty thick debris and shallow water to get us as close as possible. And then Jaime led us the rest of the way on land and water to experience these majestic waterfalls! We had a blast!

quotes.author: Tammy T
quotes.text: Couples weekend trip Our 49th Anniversary was July 9, and we decided to take a trip with some other couples.Booked the Dabnling Duck boat cruise and Captain Jamie and Shane were amazing.She was very knowledgeable and help navigate us to the perfect spots and we got some really great pictures.Thank you for everything.Tammy from Tuscaloosa Al.

+1Jamie and Shane are the best captains! And just the sweetest people. I have done Charters to the falls with family and friends Two years in a row. I’m sure I will be going again in the future. I highly recommend Dabbling Duck. It’s a great way to see the falls. An overall enjoyable experience!

quotes.author: Conway69
quotes.text: A MUST DO ADVENTURE Couldn’t have been a more beautiful and wonderful Tuesday afternoon! We had such a fabulous day!! Absolutely Gorgeous and Captain Shane & Captain Jaime were perfect hosts! And of course “The Queen” Burgess Falls was breathtaking!! Franchers Falls was also such a treat!
